The saints of the Most High will receive the kingdom and possess it forever and ever.
What did Daniel want to know more about?
Daniel wanted to know more about the fourth beast, which was different from all the others, very terrifying, with iron teeth and bronze claws, and which devoured, crushed, and trampled with its feet.
What did Daniel want to know about the horns on the fourth beast’s head?
Daniel wanted to know about the ten horns and about the little horn that came up and caused three horns to fall, the horn that had eyes and a boastful mouth and looked greater than the others.
What did Daniel see the little horn doing to the saints?
Daniel saw the horn making war against the saints and defeating them.
What happened when the Ancient of Days came?
The Ancient of Days came, judgment was given in favor of the saints of the Most High, and the time came for the saints to possess the kingdom.
When Daniel asked one standing there about the fourth beast, what did that one say the fourth beast was and would do to the earth?
That one said the fourth beast was a fourth kingdom and that it would devour the whole earth, trample it down, and crush it.
What did the one standing there say about the ten horns?
That one standing there said that ten kings would arise out of the fourth kingdom.
What will the one who speaks against the Most High do, and what will be his end?

He will oppress the holy people of the Most High. He will try to change the festivals and the law. He will have power over the saints for a time, times, and half a time, but his authority will be taken away and completely destroyed at the end.
To whom will the kingdom and dominion under the whole heaven be given?
It will be given to the people who belong to the Most High.
What was Daniel’s response to this vision?
Daniel was greatly alarmed and his face changed in appearance, but he kept the vision to himself.
When did Daniel have his second vision?
Daniel had his second vision in the third year of the reign of King Belshazzar.
Where was Daniel in his vision?
Daniel was in the fortified city of Susa in the province of Elam beside the Ulai Canal.
What were the two animals Daniel saw in this vision?
Daniel saw a ram and a male goat in this vision.
What were the ram’s two horns like?
One of the ram’s horns was longer than the other, but the horn that grew later eventually became the longer one.
No animal could stand before the ram. None could be rescued from the ram’s hand. It did whatever it wanted, and it became great.
What kind of horns did the goat have?
The goat had only one large horn between its eyes.
How did the goat approach the ram?
The goat ran at the ram in great anger.
What did the goat do to the ram?
The goat struck the ram, broke off its two horns, knocked it down to the ground, and trampled on it.
When the large horn of the goat was broken off, what grew in its place?
Four other large horns, pointing north, south, east, and west, grew up in place of the one that was broken off.
What happened to one of the goat’s four horns?
Out of one of the horns grew another horn, small at first, but it became very large toward the south, the east, and the beautiful land of Israel.
What did this horn do when it became large?
It grew strong enough to attack heaven’s army, throwing some of the army and some of the stars down to the earth and trampling on them.
What did this horn do to the commander of heaven’s army and his sanctuary?
It stopped the daily sacrifices to Yahweh, the commander of heaven’s army, and it ruined his sanctuary.
Why will the army be given over to the goat’s horn and the burnt offering stopped?
This will happen because of rebellion.
What did Daniel hear one holy one ask another?
He heard one ask how long the vision about the sacrifices being stopped, the sin, and the trampling of the sanctuary and the army would last.
How long will these things last, this vision about the burnt offering, the sin that brings destruction, the handing over of the sanctuary, and heaven’s army being trampled on?
It will last for 2,300 evenings and mornings.
What did Daniel do after he saw the vision?
He tried to understand it, and then someone who looked like a man appeared in front of him.
Who was told to help Daniel understand the vision?
Gabriel was told to help Daniel understand the vision.
What happened when the angel came near Daniel?
Daniel was frightened and fell facedown on the ground. But the angel told him to understand that the vision was about the time of the end.
What happened to Daniel while the angel was speaking with him?
Daniel fell into a deep sleep with his face to the ground, but the angel touched him and made him stand up again.
For when was the vision? What time did it concern?
The vision was for the time of wrath. It concerned the fixed time for the end.
What did the ram with two horns and the male goat represent in Daniel’s vision?
The ram with the two horns represents the kings of Media and Persia. The male goat is the king of Greece.
What did the four horns represent, the horns that came in place of the horn that was broken off?
The four horns represent four kingdoms that will arise from the nation represented by the horn that was broken off.
What kind of king will arise at the end of those kingdoms’ rule?
A fierce king will arise who defeats his enemies in battle and who is very deceitful.
What will this intelligent, grim-faced king do?

He will cause widespread destruction and succeed in whatever he does. He will destroy powerful people, people who are holy. He will make deceit prosper under his hand. He will rise up against God, who rules over all earthly kings.
What will finally happen to the intelligent, grim-faced king?
He will be broken, but not by human power.
What did the angel tell Daniel to do with the vision?
He told Daniel that the vision was true, but that Daniel should keep it secret because it would not happen for a long time.
How did this vision affect Daniel?
Daniel was overcome and lay weak for several days, and he was appalled by the vision.
Who was made king over the kingdom of the Chaldeans?
Darius, the son of Ahasuerus, who was a Mede, was made king over the kingdom of the Chaldeans.
What did Daniel observe by studying Yahweh’s word to Jeremiah the prophet?
He observed that Jerusalem would be desolate for seventy years.
How did Daniel seek the Lord God?
Daniel sought the Lord God with prayer and requests, with fasting, wearing sackcloth, and sitting in ashes.
What was the first thing Daniel did when he went to the Lord God in prayer?
Daniel confessed the sins of the Israelites.
What did Daniel say the Israelites had done against the Lord?
Daniel said they had sinned, done wrong, acted wickedly, rebelled, and turned away from the Lord’s commandments and judgments.
To whom did the prophets speak in the name of God?
The prophets spoke to the kings, the leaders, the ancestors, and to all the people of the land.
Who did Daniel say was in a shameful condition because of their sins?
Daniel said the people of Judah, the people of Jerusalem, and all of Israel, both near and far, were in a shameful condition because they had sinned against the Lord.
Why were the Israelites in a shameful condition?
They were in a shameful condition because they had sinned against Yahweh.
What did Daniel ask the Lord to give, even though the Israelites had rebelled against him?
Daniel asked the Lord to give compassion and forgiveness.
What did Daniel say the Israelites had not done, even though Yahweh gave them his laws through the prophets?
Daniel said the Israelites had not listened to Yahweh’s voice or obeyed his laws.
What had been poured out on Israel because of their sin?
The curse and oath that are written in the law of Moses, the servant of God, had been poured out on them.
How did Yahweh confirm the words he spoke against Israel and their rulers?
Yahweh confirmed his words by bringing on Israel and their rulers a great disaster.
What did Daniel say the Israelites had not done to ask Yahweh for mercy?
Daniel said they had not turned away from their sins and had not paid attention to Yahweh’s truth.
What did Daniel say Yahweh did because the Israelites did not listen to his voice?
Daniel said Yahweh watched over the trouble and brought it upon the Israelites, because Yahweh is righteous in all his deeds.
How did the Lord bring his people out of Egypt?
The Lord brought his people out of Egypt with a mighty hand.
What did Daniel ask the Lord to stop doing to Jerusalem, because of the Lord’s righteous deeds?
Daniel asked the Lord to stop being angry with Jerusalem, because of the Lord’s righteous deeds in the past.
What did Daniel ask God to do for his ruined sanctuary?
Daniel asked God to listen to his prayer and to regard his ruined sanctuary favorably again, for the Lord’s own sake.
What did Daniel say was the reason he was asking God for help, instead of the Israelites’ own righteous deeds?
Daniel said he was asking God for help because of God’s great mercies, not because of their own righteous deeds.
What four things did Daniel ask the Lord to do?
Daniel asked the Lord to hear, forgive, pay attention, and act without delay.
What was Daniel doing when he prayed to Yahweh about the holy mountain?
Daniel was speaking, praying, and confessing his sin and the sin of his people Israel.
When did Gabriel come to Daniel?
Gabriel came to Daniel at the time of the evening sacrifice while Daniel was praying.
Why did Gabriel come to Daniel?
Gabriel came to give Daniel insight and understanding.
When did the word come forth that Gabriel came to declare to Daniel?
The word came forth at the beginning of Daniel’s supplications, because God loves Daniel very much.
Why were seventy sevens of years decreed for Daniel’s people and his holy city?

The seventy sevens of years were decreed to end transgression, to put an end to sin, to atone for wickedness, to bring everlasting righteousness, to carry out the vision and the prophecy, and to consecrate the most holy place.
How much time will elapse between the issuing of the order to restore and rebuild Jerusalem to the coming of the anointed one?
Seven sevens and sixty-two sevens will elapse between the two events.
When will the anointed one die?
He will die after the sixty-two sevens of years.
What will a coming ruler do?
He will confirm a covenant with many for one seven. In the middle of the seven he will put an end to the sacrifice and the offering.
What will happen to the one who makes desolate?
Yahweh has determined that he will finally punish the ruler who made the temple unclean.
What message was revealed to Daniel in the third year of Cyrus king of Persia?
The message was about a great war.
How was Daniel able to understand the message?
Daniel understood the message because he had insight from a vision.
Daniel was mourning for three weeks.
What did Daniel not do during those three weeks?
He did not eat any fine food or meat, drink wine, or put oil on himself.
Where was Daniel on the twenty-fourth day of the first month?
He was beside the great river, the Tigris.
Who did Daniel see in his vision?
He saw a man dressed in linen with a fine gold belt around his waist.
What was the man in Daniel’s vision like?

The man’s body was like beryl, his face was like lightning, his eyes were like flaming torches, his arms and feet were like polished bronze, and the sound of his words was like the sound of a multitude.
What happened to the men who were with Daniel?
They did not see the vision, but they were terrified and ran away to hide themselves.
What was Daniel’s response when he saw the great vision and heard the man’s words?
Daniel’s face turned pale, and no strength remained in him. He fell into a deep sleep with his face to the ground.
What happened when the hand touched Daniel?
It made him get up, trembling, onto his hands and knees.
What did the man tell Daniel to do?
He told Daniel to understand the words he was about to speak and to stand up, because he had been sent to him.
When was the angel sent to Daniel?
The angel was sent on the first day Daniel set his mind to understand and humble himself before God.
Why did it take the angel twenty-one days to come to Daniel?
The angel was detained by the prince of the kingdom of Persia who resisted him.
When will the events of the vision happen?
The vision was about the last days, the days yet to come.
What did Daniel do while the man was speaking to him?
Daniel looked down at the ground and said nothing.
What did Daniel say the vision had done to him?
Daniel said the vision had greatly upset him, and that he had no strength left and could hardly breathe.
What did the one with an appearance like a human being do to strengthen Daniel?
The one who looked like a human being touched Daniel to strengthen him.
What did the man tell Daniel?
He told Daniel not to be afraid, wished him peace, and told him to be strong.
What did the one who looked like a human being say he was going to do after he left Daniel?
He said he was returning to fight against the prince of Persia.
What did the one who looked like a human being say he was going to tell Daniel?
He said he was going to tell Daniel what was written in the book of truth.
Whom did the messenger help and protect during the first year that Darius the Mede was king?
The messenger helped and protected Michael that year.
How will a fourth king in Persia gain power?
He will gain power through his riches.
Against what kingdom will that fourth Persian king stir up everyone?
He will stir up everyone against the kingdom of Javan.
What will a mighty king do when he rises to power?
He will rule with great dominion and do whatever he wants.
To whom will the kingdom of the mighty king not be given?
That kingdom will not be given to the king’s own descendants.
The king of the south and one of his commanders who will become a king of the north will make an alliance.
Who will come to confirm the alliance between the king of the south and the king of the north?
The daughter of the king of the south will come to the king of the north to confirm the agreement.
What will the branch from the daughter of the king of the south do to the king of the north?
He will attack the army and enter the fortress of the king of the north and conquer them.
What will the king of the south take back to Egypt?
He will take the idols, metal images, and silver and gold treasures of the north to Egypt.
What will happen when the king of the north invades the southern kingdom?
He will have to retreat back to his own land.
What will the sons of the king of the north do?
They will wage war and assemble a great army. They will overflow like a flood, pass through, and repeat the assault all the way to the fortress of the king of the south.
Who will win this battle between the north and the south?
The king of the south will win that battle.
What will the king of the south do in response to the attack by the sons of the king of the north?
The king of the south will march out in a rage and fight against the king of the north.
After some years, what will the king of the north do?
He will raise another great army supplied with much equipment and will surely come.
In those times who else will rise against the king of the south?
In those times many will rise against the king of the south, including the most violent among Daniel’s people.
What will happen this time when the king of the north attacks the king of the south?
The king of the south will not be able to stand against him. The king of the north will do whatever he wants against the king of the south.
Why will the king of the north give a daughter in marriage to the king of the south?
The king of the north will do this in order to destroy the kingdom of the south.
What will happen to this king of the North?
A commander will defeat him and shame him, instead of being shamed himself. Then he will retreat to the fortresses of his own land, but he will stumble and die, and no one will find him.
What will the one who rises up in place of the king of the north do?
He will force taxes to be paid to provide for the splendor of the kingdom.
What will happen to this one who forces taxes to be paid?
After only a few days that one will be destroyed, but not in anger or in battle.
How will a despised person who has not been given the honor of royalty come to power?
He will come to power quietly, when people are not expecting it, and will take over the kingdom by making secret plots.
Whom will the despised king also remove, besides defeating the armies opposing him?
He will also remove God’s high priest, the leader of the covenant.
What will this despised king do once an alliance is made with him?
From the time an alliance is made with him, he will act deceitfully.
What will the king do with the plunder he takes from the richest parts of the province?
He will give the plunder, spoil, and wealth to his troops and supporters.
What will happen when this deceitful king wages war against the king of the south?
The king of the south will not be able to stand against the deceitful king because of all the plots devised against him.
Who will help destroy the king of the south?
Some of his own royal officials will help destroy him, and many of his soldiers will be killed.
Why will the king of the north and the king of the south sit at the same table and lie to each other?
They will lie to each other because their hearts are set on evil against each other.
What will the heart of the king of the north be set against?
His heart will be set against the holy covenant.
What will happen when the king of the north invades the south again at the appointed time?
He will invade again, but this time it will not go as it did before.
How will the king of the north show his rage against the holy covenant?
He will show his rage by favoring those who abandon the holy covenant.
What will the king’s army do to the sanctuary?
They will make the sanctuary unclean, stop the regular sacrifice, and set up the abomination that makes it desolate.
How will the people who know their God respond to the king’s flattery?
They will be strong and take action against him.
What will happen to the wise?
For a time, the wise will fall by the sword and by flame, be taken as prisoners, and be robbed of their possessions. When they stumble, they will receive a little help.
What will the wise do at that time?
At that time, the wise will give understanding to many.
Why will some of the wise stumble?
Some of them will stumble so that they may be refined, cleansed, and made pure until the time of the end.
Above whom will this deceitful king of the north exalt himself?
He will exalt and magnify himself above every god, including the God of gods, the gods of his ancestors, and the god desired by women.
What god will the king honor instead of the gods of his fathers?
He will honor a god of fortresses that his ancestors did not know, honoring it with gold, silver, precious stones, and other valuable things.
What will this deceitful king of the north do for those who acknowledge him?
He will give honor to those who acknowledge him. He will make them rulers over many people.
What will the king of the north use to attack at the time of the end?
He will attack with chariots, horsemen, and many ships, invading many countries.
At the time of the end, what will happen when the king of the north comes into the glorious land?
Many people in that land will stumble and fall.
Who will escape from the hand of the king of the north?
Edom, Moab, and most of the people of Ammon will escape from his hand.
What are some of the countries over which this king of the north will extend his power?
This king of the north will extend his power over Egypt, the Libyans, and the Cushites.
What will this king of the north do when reports from the east and north alarm him?
He will go out with great rage to destroy and to devote many to destruction.
Where will this king of the north set up the tents of his palace?
He will set up the tents of his palace between the seas, at the mountain of the beauty of holiness.
Who will help the king of the north at the end?
The king of the north will come to his end, and there will be no one to help him.
Who is it that guards Daniel’s people?
Michael, the great prince, guards Daniel’s people.
How bad will the time of trouble be?
It will be a time of trouble such as never was since the beginning of any nation until that time.
At that time who will be saved?
At that time Daniel’s people will be saved, everyone whose name is found written in the book.
What will happen to many of those who sleep in the dust of the earth?
Some of those who sleep in the dust of the earth will rise up to everlasting life, and some will rise up to shame and everlasting contempt.
What will happen to those who are wise and those who turn many to righteousness?
Those who are wise will shine like the brightness of the sky above, and those who turn many to righteousness will shine like the stars forever and ever.
How long was Daniel told to keep the book sealed?
He was told to keep the book sealed until the time of the end.
Who did Daniel see standing beside the river?
Daniel saw two other men, one standing on each side of the river.
What did one of the two men ask the man clothed in linen?
He asked how long it would be until the end of these wonders.
How long did the man clothed in linen say it would be until the end of these amazing events?
The man clothed in linen said it would be for a time, times, and a half. When the shattering of the power of the holy people comes to an end, all these things will be completed.
What did Daniel ask after he heard but did not understand?
Daniel asked what would be the end of these things.
What did the man clothed in linen say when Daniel told him he did not understand?
The man clothed in linen said to Daniel, “Go your way, Daniel, for the words are shut up and sealed until the time of the end.”
At the time of the end, who will and who will not understand the words of the prophecy?
None of the wicked will understand, but those who are wise will understand.
How much time will elapse between the time that the perpetual sacrifice is removed and the abomination that causes desolation is set up?
There will be 1,290 days between those two events.
At that time who does the man clothed in linen say will be blessed?
The man clothed in linen said, “Blessed is the one who waits until the end of the 1,335 days.”
What did the man clothed in linen say would happen to Daniel?
He said that Daniel would rest and that he would rise for his reward at the end of days.
What kind of wife did Yahweh tell Hosea to take for himself?
Yahweh told him to marry a prostitute.
Hosea married Gomer, the daughter of Diblaim.
Why was Hosea told to name his first son Jezreel?
Hosea was told to name his son Jezreel because Yahweh was soon going to punish the descendants of Jehu for the people he had slaughtered at Jezreel.
What did Yahweh say he would do to Israel’s army in the Valley of Jezreel?
Yahweh said he would destroy Israel’s army in the Valley of Jezreel.
What name did Yahweh tell Hosea to give his daughter?
Yahweh told him to call her Lo Ruhamah.
On whom will Yahweh have compassion?
Yahweh will have compassion on the people of Judah.
What did Gomer do after she weaned Lo Ruhamah?
She conceived and gave birth to another son.
Why did Yahweh tell Hosea to name of his second son Lo Ammi?
Hosea was told to name his son Lo Ammi to show that the Israelites were no longer Yahweh’s people.
What will be said to those who formerly were told they were not Yahweh’s people?
It will be said to them that they are sons of the living God.
What will the people of Judah and Israel do together in the future?
They will unite and choose one leader for themselves.
What should the people say to their brothers and sisters?
They should say to their brothers, “Ammi,” and to their sisters, “Ruhamah.”
What will Yahweh do if Israel (the prostitute) does not put away her prostitution?
If Israel (the prostitute) does not put away her prostitution, Yahweh will strip her naked and show her nakedness as on the day that she was born.
Why will Yahweh not have compassion on Israel’s (the prostitute’s) children?
Yahweh will not have compassion on her children, because they are as unfaithful as their prostitute mother.
What did the children’s mother say she would do?
She said she would go after her lovers, who gave her bread, water, wool, linen, oil, and wine to drink.
What will Yahweh do to block Israel’s (the prostitute’s) way?
He will block her way with thorns and build a wall in her way so that she does not know what to do.
Why will Israel (the prostitute) return to her first husband?
She will return to her first husband because she thinks it was better for her then than now.
Who gave Israel (the prostitute) silver and gold?
Yahweh gave them silver and gold, which the people used to make idols for Baal.
What will Yahweh take back from Israel (the prostitute)?
He will take back his grain, new wine, wool, and linen that were meant to cover their bodies.
What will Yahweh do to Israel (the prostitute) in front of her lovers?
Yahweh will expose their shameful behavior in front of their (gods) lovers.
What will Yahweh cause to cease?
He will cause all their celebrations to cease.
What wages did Israel’s (the prostitute’s) lovers give her?
Israel’s lovers gave her grapevines and fig trees.
What did Israel (the prostitute) do when she went after her lovers?
They burned incense to the Baals, put on their jewelry, and forgot Yahweh.
What will Yahweh do to persuade Israel (the prostitute)?
He will lead her into the wilderness and speak tenderly to her.
How will Israel (the prostitute) answer Yahweh after he goes to win her back?
She will answer him as she did in the days of her youth, as in the days that she came out of the land of Egypt.
In that day, what will Israel (the prostitute) call Yahweh?
She will call him “My Husband,” and no longer “My Baal.”
What will Yahweh remove from Israel’s (the prostitute’s) mouth?
He will not allow them to speak the names of the Baals, and they will never use those names again.
What will Yahweh allow his people do?
He will allow them to be able to live safely and peacefully.
For how long did Yahweh promise his people they will belong to him?
Yahweh promised that they will belong to him forever.
How will the people know that they truly will know Yahweh?
Yahweh will be faithful to them.
What will Yahweh answer on that day?
He will tell the heavens to send rain and water the earth.
What will the earth provide for Jezreel?
The earth will produce grain, new wine and olive oil for Jezreel.
What will Yahweh say to Lo Ammi?
Yahweh will say to Lo Ammi, “You are my people.”
In what way must Hosea love his wife?
Hosea must love her just as Yahweh loves the people of Israel.
For how much did Hosea buy back his wife?
He bought her for fifteen pieces of silver and 335 liters of barley.
What does Hosea tell his wife she must not do?
Hosea tells his wife that she must not be a prostitute and must not have sex with any other man.
After the people of Israel live for many days without a king, who will they seek?
After the people of Israel live for many days without a king, they will again worship Yahweh their God.
Against whom does Yahweh have a dispute?
Yahweh has a dispute with the people who live in the land.
What sins does Yahweh say the people are committing?
The people are cursing, lying, murdering, stealing, and committing adultery.
What is happening to everyone living in the land?
Everyone living in it is wasting away.
The people are like those who argue with a priest.
The prophet will stumble along with the people by night.
Why will Yahweh reject the people of Israel?
Yahweh will reject the people of Israel because they forgot and rejected the laws of their God.
What will Yahweh do instead of honoring them because they sinned?
Yahweh will make people despise them instead of honoring them.
What do the priests do with the sin offerings the people bring?
The priests eat the sin offerings, and they want the people to sin even more.
What will happen to the priest, just as it happens to the people?
Yahweh will punish the priest the same as the people, paying them back for what they have done.
What will happen even though the people eat?
They will eat but will still be hungry.
What things make people unable to think clearly?
Prostitution, wine, and new wine make people unable to think clearly.
What do Yahweh’s people ask to guide them?
They ask their wooden idols to guide them.
Where do the people sacrifice and burn incense?
They sacrifice on the mountaintops and burn incense on the hills, and under oak, poplar, and terebinth trees.
Why will Yahweh not punish the people’s daughters when they choose to commit sexual immorality?
Yahweh will not punish the people’s daughters when they choose to commit sexual immorality, for the men also give themselves and offer sacrifices with the shrine prostitutes.
Where should the people not go?
They should not go to Gilgal or Beth Aven to worship idols there.
What is Israel compared to because of its stubbornness?
Israel is compared to a stubborn cow that refuses to obey.
What has Ephraim chosen to do?
Ephraim has chose to worship idols.
What did the leaders of Ephraim love?
The leaders of Ephraim loved shameful things.
What will make the people ashamed?
Their sacrifices to idols will make them ashamed.
Who does Yahweh tell to pay attention?
Yahweh tells the priests, the people of Israel, and the members of the royal court to pay attention because he is going to judge them.
What have the revolters done, and what will Yahweh do to them?
They have killed many people, and Yahweh will punish all of them.
What does Yahweh say about Ephraim and Israel?
Yahweh says he knows that they have been unfaithful to him by worshiping idols and have made themselves unacceptable to him.
What will not allow Ephraim to return to their God?
The evil things Ephraim has done will not allow them to worship their God any more.
What will happen to Israel, Ephraim, and Judah because of their sin?
The people of Israel, Ephraim, and Judah will fail because of how much they have sinned.
Why will the people not find Yahweh?
The people will not find Yahweh because he has removed himself from them.
What will Yahweh do to them when they bring their sacrifices to the festival?
Yahweh will kill them, because they have betrayed him and do not belong to him.
Where should the trumpet and horn be blown?
The horn should be blown in Gibeah, the trumpet in Ramah, and the alarm sounded at Beth Aven.
Who declared that Ephraim will become a desolation?
Yahweh declared that Ephraim will become desolate when he punishes them.
On whom will Yahweh pour his wrath?
Yahweh will punish the leaders of Judah because of his wrath.
What will happen to Ephraim when Yahweh judges them?
The people of Ephraim will suffer greatly because they were determined to worship worthless idols.
What will Yahweh do to Ephraim and Judah?
Yahweh will destroy the people of Ephraim like a moth destroys wool, and he will destroy the people of Judah like rot destroys wood.
When did Ephraim go to Assyria?
When Ephraim saw that their nation was weak, then they went to Assyria for help.
What does Yahweh say he will do to Ephraim and Judah?
Yahweh will cause soldiers to kill many of them and carry the others away, and there will be no one to rescue them.
For how long will Yahweh leave them to themselves?
Yahweh will leave them to themselves until they admit that they have sinned and that they need him to forgive them; until they earnestly ask him to help them.
Although Yahweh hurt his people, what will he then do?
Although he hurt them, he will heal them and bind up their wounds.
When will Yahweh make his people strong again?
He will make them strong again after a short time so that they may live in his presence.
What do the people say they need to do?
They say they need to try hard to know Yahweh.
To what does Yahweh compare the people’s faithfulness?
He compares their faithful love for him to the mist or the dew in the morning; neither lasts very long.
What did Yahweh do through the prophets?
He sent them to warn the people that he would judge them.
What does God desire more than sacrifice?
God desired covenant faithfulness more than sacrifice, and the knowledge of him more than burnt offerings.
What does Yahweh say the people did like Adam?
Like Adam, they broke his covenant and were unfaithful to him.
What does Yahweh say about the city of Gilead?
Gilead is a city full of people who do evil things and murder people.
To what does the speaker compare the terrible and shameful things the priests have done?
The priests actions are compared to gangs of robbers who join together to commit murder on the way to Shechem.
What horrible thing has Yahweh seen among the people of Israel?
Ephraim had become like a prostitute when they stopped worshiping him, and Israel’s sin had made them unacceptable to Yahweh.
What did Yahweh say he has appointed for Judah?
Yahweh said he has appointed a time when he will judge them, when he restores the fortunes of his people.
What does Yahweh see when he wants to heal Israel?
He sees how sinfully the people of Ephraim act and all of the evil things that the people of the city of Samaria do.
Yahweh remembered every evil thing that they do.
How did the people make the king glad?
The people of Israel please their king by doing evil things.
What does Yahweh compare the people to?
He compares them to adulterers because they are unfaithful to him.
What happened to the king on the day of his festival?
The officials made him drunk with wine until he became sick, and he joined with those who mock Yahweh.
What were the people’s hearts like?
Their hearts were as hot with anger as the heat of an oven.
What happened to all the kings of Israel?
All of their kings died violently; yet none of them called out to Yahweh for help.
Ephraim has become ruined because of his alliances with foreign nations.
What did the people not realize was happening to them?
Foreigners have drained away their resources and their nation is becoming powerless yet the people of Israel do not realize it.
What have the people of Israel not done despite everything that has happened?
They have not returned to worship Yahweh their God or tried to know him.
What made Ephraim like a dove?
Ephraim was as foolish and stupid as a dove because they asked other nations instead of Yahweh to help them.
What will Yahweh do to them?
He will not allow them to succeed but instead will punish them.
Why did Yahweh not rescue the people?
Yahweh did not rescue the people because they spoke lies against him.
What did the people do instead of crying out to Yahweh for help?
They just lie on their beds and wail.
What does Yahweh say he did for the people?
He trained them and made them strong.
Why will the officials die in battle?
The officials will die in battle because what they said made Yahweh very angry.
Why was an enemy watching Yahweh’s people like a vulture watching over its prey?
Israel’s enemy was ready to invade the land where the people of Yahweh lived because they had broke his covenant and rebelled against his law.
What do the people of Israel say to Yahweh?
They say that they know him as their God.
What will happen because Israel has rejected what is good?
An enemy will chase after Israel.
What did the people use to make idols for themselves?
They used their silver and gold to make idols for themselves.
What does Yahweh say about Samaria’s calf idol?
Yahweh says that he rejects it, and that he is very angry with the people of Samaria.
What does Yahweh say about the calf idol of Samaria?
He says a craftsman made it, so it is not God, and it will be broken into pieces.
To what does the speaker compare the foolish things Israel has done?
The foolish plans the people have made are like they tried to plant the wind which of course will produce nothing good.
What does Yahweh say Israel has become among the nations?
Israel has become just like the other nations, with nothing special about them.
What has Ephraim done to get help from other nations?
Ephraim has gone to Assyria and paid other nations to be their allies.
What will Yahweh do now that they have paid other nations to help them?
Now that they paid another nation to help them, Yahweh will punish them by making them suffer under the demands of the king of that nation.
What happened to the altars that Ephraim built to take away sin?
Those altars became places where Ephraim sinned even more.
Even if Yahweh wrote down his law for them ten thousand times, how would they view it?
They would still consider that it did not apply to them.
How will Yahweh punish the people’s sins?
He will punish their sins by making them become slaves again, like they were in Egypt.
What does Yahweh say Israel did?
Israel forgot the God who made them and built palaces for themselves instead.
Israel should not rejoice because they have been unfaithful to their God.
What will happen to Israel’s food supply?
There will not be enough grain or wine to feed them.
What will happen to the people of Ephraim?
Ephraim will no longer live in the land Yahweh gave them, but will return to slavery and eat unclean food in Assyria.
How does Yahweh respond to Israel’s offerings and sacrifices?
Their offerings sacrifices will not be pleasing to Yahweh.
What will the people no longer be able to do once they are in exile?
They will not be able to celebrate the feasts and festivals that Yahweh has appointed for them.
What will happen to Israel’s treasures of silver?
Weeds will take over their precious silver and thorns will fill their tents.
Why is God going to punish the Israelites?
Because of Israel’s great iniquity and great hostility.
What is the role of the prophet?
The prophet is the watchman with God over Ephraim.
To what does Hosea compare Israel’s current corruption?
He compares it to just how sinful the people of Gibeah were long ago.
What will God do about Israel’s sins?
God will punish them for how wickedly they have acted.
What did Israel’s ancestors do when they came to Baal Peor?
They devoted themselves to the worship of shameful idol.
What does Yahweh say he will do even if the people of Ephraim is able to raise children?
He will take away every one of them.
What will happen to Ephraim’s children?
Their children will be slaughtered by their enemies.
What does Hosea ask Yahweh to give to Ephraim?
He asks Yahweh to give them miscarriages and no way to nurse babies.
What does Yahweh say he will do because of the evil things the people of Israel have done?
Yahweh will drive them out of the land and will no longer love them no.
What would happen even if Ephraim had children?
Even if they have children, Yahweh will kill the children whom they love.
God rejects Israel because they have not listened to him.
What will happen to Israel after God rejects them?
They will become wanderers among the nations.
What happened as the people of Israel became more prosperous?
The more the people prospered, the more altars they built.
What is the consequence of the people’s sin?
Yahweh will destroy their sacred altars and pillars.
Why did they no longer have a king?
They had no king because they had not feared or honored Yahweh.
Why were the covenants the people made worthless?
Israel made covenants that they did not keep.
What will the people of Samaria do because of the calf idol of Beth Aven?
They will be afraid about what will happen to the idol, and the people and priests will mourn and cry out because it is gone.
Why will the calf idol of Beth Aven be carried to Assyria?
It will be carried to Assyria as a gift for the its king.
What will happen to the king of Samaria?
He will be no more, like a chip of wood floating away on the water.
What will grow over the altar?
Thorns and thistles will grow over the altar.
What will happen to the wicked people of Gibeah?
What will Yahweh do when he decides to punish them?
He will allow armies from other nations to attack and capture them.
What will Yahweh make the people of Ephraim, Judah, and Jacob do?
Yahweh will make Ephraim work hard, Judah will have to plow, and Jacob will have to break up the ground with no one to help them.
For how long should the people seek Yahweh?
They should seek Yahweh until he comes and blesses them.
What did the people trust in for their security rather than in Yahweh?
They trusted that their many warriors would protect them.
What happened to mothers with their children when Shalman destroyed Beth Arbel?
When Shalman destroyed Beth Arbel, mothers were dashed to pieces with their children.
Why will the king of Israel be destroyed at Bethel?
The king will be destroyed because of the wickedness of the people.
From where did Yahweh call Israel when Israel was a young nation?
When Israel was a child, Yahweh brought them out of Egypt.
What did the Israelites keep doing instead of listening to Yahweh?
The Israelites kept offering sacrifices to the Baal gods and burning incense to honor their statues.
How did Yahweh lead his people?
Yahweh gently guided them because he loved them.
Who will rule over them since they refuse to worship Yahweh?
The king of Assyria will rule over them because they refused to worship Yahweh any more.
What will happen to Israel’s cities because of their evil plans?
Enemies will attack their cities with swords, destroy the bars of their gates, and kill the people.
What are Yahweh’s people determined to do?
Yahweh’s people are determined to turn away and stop worshiping him.
What happened to the cities of Admah and Zeboiim that Yahweh wants to avoid doing to Ephraim and Israel?
Yahweh doesn’t want to destroy Ephraim and Israel the way he destroyed the cities of Admah and Zeboiim because he loves them too much.
Why will Yahweh not destroy Ephraim again?
Although Yahweh is extremely angry, he will not destroy Ephraim again, for he is God and not a human.
What will happen to the people when Yahweh calls out?
The Israelites will return to Yahweh and will come back from lands around the sea.
What does Yahweh say he will do when the people return?
He will settle them in their homes again.
Judah still remains faithful and obeys God.
What did Ephraim do to get help from other nations?
Ephraim made a treaty with Assyria and sent oil to Egypt.
What did Yahweh punish Jacob for?
Yahweh punished the descendants of Jacob for how they lived and the things they had done.
What did Jacob do in the womb?
In the womb, Jacob grabbed his brother by the heel.
Where did God speak to Jacob?
God spoke with Jacob at Bethel.
By what name were the people commanded to call God?
The name “Yahweh” is the name that he commanded the people to always use.
For what should the people wait?
They should wait continually for their God by trusting in him.
What do the merchants use to cheat people?
The merchants use dishonest scales to cheat people.
What did Ephraim claim no one would find in his work?
He boasted that in all of his labor, no one will find anything wrong that would be considered sin.
Where did the people live when Yahweh brought them out of Egypt?
The people lived in tents when they left the land of Egypt.
What did Yahweh use the prophets to give to the people?
Yahweh used the prophets to give visions and parables to the people.
What will Gilgal’s altars be like?
Gilgal’s altars will be like piles of stones left on a plowed field.
Jacob fled to the land of Aram to escape from his brother Esau.
What did Yahweh do by a prophet?
Yahweh used the prophet Moses when he brought Israel up from Egypt, and by that same prophet, he took care of them.
What will Ephraim’s Lord do to him?
His Lord will hold Ephraim responsible for the bloodshed and give him what he deserves.
He became guilty by worshiping Baal.
What do the people have made from their silver?
Skilled craftsmen make idols for the people from their silver.
Chaff is blown away from the threshing floor by the wind.
Who does Yahweh say is the only savior for his people?
Yahweh says that he himself is the only savior for his people.
Where did Yahweh remind the people that he had cared for them?
Yahweh cared for his people in the wilderness, in the dry desert land.
What happened when the people’s hunger was satisfied?
When Yahweh’s people had enough to satisfy their hunger, they became proud and forgot him.
What will Yahweh be like to his people?
Yahweh will be like a fierce lion, and like a leopard that watches along the path to attack.
Like what will Yahweh attack his people?
He will attack them like a bear that is robbed of her cubs.
Israel’s destruction happened because they rebelled against Yahweh, their helper.
What did the people ask Yahweh to give them?
The people asked Yahweh to give them a king and princes.
What did Yahweh do to the king he gave them?
Yahweh took the king away because of his wrath.
What does Yahweh do with Ephraim’s sin?
Yahweh stores up and keeps a record of Ephraim’s sin.
What did Yahweh wish he could rescue the people from?
Yahweh wanted to save them from death.
His enemy will plunder the treasury of all their valuable objects.
What will happen to Samaria’s young children?
Their young children will be dashed to pieces.
Why should Israel begin to worship and obey Yahweh again?
Israel should return to worshiping Yahweh because terrible things are happening to them because of their sin.
What does Israel ask Yahweh to do?
Israel asks Yahweh to forgive their sin since they now say they will do what is good.
Who will not be able to save Israel?
Why will Yahweh love Israel generously?
Yahweh will love them generously because he will no longer be angry with them.
What does Yahweh say he will be like to Israel?
Yahweh says he will be like the dew that the refreshes the ground to Israel and they will prosper and become strong as the trees of Lebanon.
What will Israel’s splendor be like?
Israel’s splendor will be as majestic as an olive tree and as delightful as the aroma of the trees in Lebanon.
How will the people speak of Yahweh?
They will speak well of Yahweh, like they speak well of the fine wine of Lebanon.
What does Yahweh say about idols to Ephraim?
Yahweh says he wants nothing more to do with idols, and that he is the one who watches over them and is the source of everything good in their lives.
Who will walk in the ways of Yahweh?
The righteous will walk in Yahweh’s ways and obey him.
The word of Yahweh came to Joel.
To whom were the elders to tell the word of Yahweh?
They were to tell their children, and their children were to tell their children.
What happened to what the hopping locusts have left?
The destroying locust ate what the hopping locusts left.
Why will drinkers of wine wail?
They will wail because the sweet wine has been cut off.
Into what has the enemy made the vine?
The enemy has made the vine into a waste.
For what reason does the virgin mourn?
The virgin mourns for the death of her young husband.
What has happened to the grain?
What has been withheld from the house of God?
The grain offering and the drink offering have been withheld from the house of God.
When will the day of Yahweh be here?
The day of Yahweh is almost here.
The storage places for grain have been broken down.
Why are the herds of cattle suffering?
The herds of cattle are suffering because they have no pasture.
For whom do the animals of the field pant?
The animals of the field pant for Yahweh.
Why should all the inhabitants of the land tremble in fear?
They should tremble in fear, for the day of Yahweh is coming.
When has there been an army like this one?
There has never been an army like this one, and there never will be again.
What is the land like behind the army?
The land behind the army is a ruined wilderness.
In what way does the locust swarm look and act like an army?
The locusts look like horses and run like horses.
How does the army enter the city?
They rush on the city, they run on the wall, they climb in houses, and they go through windows like thieves.
They should tear their hearts and not their garments.
Why should the people return to Yahweh?
He is gracious and merciful, slow to anger and abundant in love, and he would like to turn from inflicting punishment.
Why should the people blow a trumpet in Zion?
They should blow a trumpet to consecrate a fast and to call a sacred assembly.
What had Yahweh’s people been among the nations?
Yahweh’s people had been a reproach, an object of scorn, among the nations.
Why should the land not fear?
The land should not fear, because Yahweh has done great things.
Will Yahweh ever bring shame on his people again?
No, he will never bring shame on his people again.
What will happen when Yahweh pours out his Spirit?
Their sons and your daughters will prophesy, their old men will dream dreams, and their young men will see visions.
What will Yahweh show in the heavens and on the earth?
Yahweh show wonders in the heavens and on the earth.
Into what will the sun turn?
The sun will turn into darkness.
Who will be saved at that time?
Everyone who calls on the name of Yahweh will be saved.
Who will Yahweh bring to the Valley of Jehoshaphat?
Yahweh will bring the nations to the Valley of Jehoshaphat.
At whom are Tyre, Sidon and all the regions of Philistia angry?
Tyre, Sidon and all the regions of Philistia are angry at Yahweh.
What did Tyre, Sidon, and Philistia do with Yahweh’s treasures?
They brought his treasures into their temples.
What did Tyre, Sidon, and Philistia do to the people of Judah and Jerusalem?
They sold the people to the Greeks in order to remove them far from their territory.
What will Yahweh do to the sons and daughters of Tyre, Sidon, and Philistia?
Yahweh will sell their sons and daughters to the Sabeans by the hand of the people of Judah.
Into what should the nations beat their plowshares?
They should beat their plowshares into swords.
What will Yahweh do to all surrounding nations?
Yahweh will sit to judge all surrounding nations.
What will happen to the sun, moon, and stars?
The sun and moon will become dark, and the stars will withdraw their brightness.
What two things will Yahweh be for his people?
Yahweh be a shelter and a stronghold for his people.
Yahweh their God lives in Zion.
With what will the hills flow?
The hills will flow with milk.
Who will be abandoned because of the violence they did to the people of Judah?
Egypt and Edom will be abandoned.
How did Amos receive the message he spoke concerning Israel?
Amos received the message he spoke concerning Israel in a vision given to him by Yahweh.
What happens to the pastures and the top of Mount Carmel when Yahweh speaks?
The pastures where shepherds usually feed their sheep and the top of Mount Carmel dry up and wither.
Why did Yahweh declare punishment against Damascus?
Yahweh declared punishment against Damascus because they cruelly attacked the people of Gilead.
What did Yahweh say he would send into the house of Hazael?
He said he would send a fire that would destroy the house of Hazael and the citadels of Ben Hadad.
Where will the people of Aram go into exile?
They will go into exile to the land of Kir.
Why did Yahweh declare punishment against Gaza?
Yahweh said he would punish Gaza because they captured whole people groups and sold them as slaves to Edom.
What did Yahweh declare he would do to the fortresses of Gaza?
Yahweh declared he would burn down the fortresses of Gaza.
What will happen to the rest of the Philistines?
All the Philistines who are still alive will die.
Why did Yahweh declare punishment against Tyre?
Yahweh declared punishment against Tyre because they exiled whole people groups to Edom and broke their treaty.
What did Yahweh declare he would do to the wall of Tyre?
He declared he would send a fire that would destroy the walls of Tyre.
Why did Yahweh declare punishment against Edom?
Yahweh declared punishment against Edom because he killed their own kinsmen.
What did Yahweh declare he would do to Teman?
He declared he would send a fire on Teman that would also burn down the citadels of Bozrah.
Why did Yahweh declare punishment against Ammon?
Yahweh declared punishment against Ammon because they ripped open the pregnant women of Gilead.
What did Yahweh declare he would do to the citadels of Rabbah?
Yahweh declared he would completely destroy the walls of the city of Rabbah and burn down her citadels.
What did Yahweh declare would happen to the king of Ammon?
Yahweh declared the king of Ammon would be exiled with all his officials.
Why did Yahweh declare punishment against Moab?
Yahweh declared punishment against Moab because they burned the bones of the king of Edom.
What did Yahweh say he would do to the city of Kerioth?
Yahweh said he would send a fire that would destroy the fortresses of the city of Kerioth.
What did Yahweh declare he would do to the judge and other leaders of Moab?
Yahweh declared that he would kill the judge and officials of Moab.
Why did Yahweh declare punishment against Judah?
Yahweh declared punishment against Judah because Judah rejected the law of Yahweh.
What did Yahweh declare he would do to the fortresses of Jerusalem?
Yahweh declared he would burn down the fortresses of Jerusalem.
What did the people of Israel do to the righteous and the needy?
The people of Israel sold the righteous for silver and the needy for a pair of sandals.
Why did Yahweh declare punishment against Israel?
Yahweh declared punishment against Israel because Israel was oppressing poor people.
What did the people of Israel do in the temple?
They drank wine bought with fines in the temple of their God.
How had the Israelites been able to defeat the Amorites?
The Israelites had been able to defeat the Amorites because Yahweh destroyed the Amorites for them.
What did Yahweh do for the Israelites after he brought them out of Egypt?
Yahweh led the Israelites in the wilderness for forty years and gave them the land of the Amorites as their own.
Whom did Yahweh choose from among the Israelites?
Yahweh chose some of their young men to be prophets and others to be Nazirites.
What did the Israelites do with the prophets Yahweh had chosen for them?
The Israelites commanded the prophets not to prophesy.
What did the Israelites do with the Nazirites Yahweh had chosen from among them?
The Israelites forced the Nazirites to break their vows not to drink wine.
What did Yahweh declare he would do to Israel?
Yahweh declared he would make them unable to escape his punishment.
What will the swift person, the strong person, and the mighty person not be able to do?
The swift person will not be able to run fast enough to escape, the strong person will not be able to add to his own strength, and the mighty person will not be able to rescue himself.
What did Yahweh declare concerning archers, fast runners, and horsemen?
Yahweh declared that none of them would be able to save themselves when he comes to punish the nation.
Against whom is this word of Yahweh?
This word of Yahweh is against the people of Israel, the descendants of those who Yahweh brought up out of Egypt.
Who did Yahweh choose from all the people groups of the earth?
Yahweh chose Israel from all the people groups of the earth.
What must two persons do in order to walk together?
Two persons must agree in order to walk together.
When does a lion roar in the forest?
A lion roars in the forest only when it has caught prey.
When does a bird get caught in a trap on the ground?
A bird gets caught in a trap on the ground only when someone has set a trap for it.
When disaster comes on a city, who has sent it?
When disaster comes on a city, Yahweh has sent it.
What does Yahweh do before he takes action?
Yahweh reveals his plan to his prophets before he takes action.
What must the prophets do when the Lord Yahweh speaks?
When the Lord Yahweh speaks, the prophets must proclaim what he says.
What would these other nations see if they could observe what was happening in Samaria?
They would see how the people are panicking and how the rulers are oppressing the people of Samaria.
What were the people of Samaria storing up in their fortresses?
Samaria was storing up the things they obtained through violence and destruction in their fortresses.
What punishment does Yahweh declare against Israel?
Yahweh declares that an enemy will plunder and tear down the fortresses of Israel.
Only a few will escape Yahweh’s punishment.
At the time when Yahweh will punish Israel for their sins, what else will he do?
Yahweh will also destroy the altars where they worship at Bethel.
What will Yahweh do to the houses of the wealthy?
Yahweh will destroy all the big fancy houses of the wealthy.
What name does Yahweh give the rich women who live in Samaria?
Yahweh calls the rich women of Samaria cows of Bashan.
What are the rich women in Samaria doing to the poor?
The rich women are oppressing the poor and causing the needy to suffer.
What does Yahweh declare will happen to the rich women in Samaria?
Yahweh declares that he allow their enemies to take these women away as captives.
What will the wealthy women do when enemies break through the walls of the city?
Each woman will go out through the gap in the wall.
What have the people of Israel loved to do?
The people of Israel loved to bring sacrifices and tithes and announce their freewill offerings but not in the way that Yahweh commanded them to do.
What did Yahweh cause to happen to the people of Israel?
Yahweh caused a famine so that the people of Israel had no food in any of their cities.
What did Yahweh do so that the people of Israel would return to him?
Yahweh withheld rain from Israel so that the people of Israel would return to him.
What did the people do when they had no water in their cities?
The people staggered to another city to get water, but they did not get enough.
What did Yahweh do to the gardens, vineyards, and trees so that the people of Israel would return to him?
Yahweh caused locusts to eat all their gardens, vineyards, and fig and olive trees.
What did Yahweh do to the young men so that the people of Israel would return to him?
Yahweh allowed their enemies to kill the young men in wars so that the people of Israel would return to him.
What did Yahweh do to some of the people of Israel so that they would return to him?
Yahweh destroyed some of the people of Israel so that they would return to him.
What does Yahweh tell the people of Israel they must now prepare to do?
Yahweh tells the people of Israel they must now prepare to meet their God.
Who formed the mountains and revealed what people are thinking?
Yahweh, God of Armies, formed the mountains and revealed what people are thinking.
The people of Israel are the ones the prophet is mourning over.
What does Yahweh say will happen to a town that sends out a thousand soldiers to fight?
A town that sends out a thousand soldiers to fight will have only a hundred who survive.
What does Yahweh tell the people of Israel to do?
Yahweh tells the people of Israel to sincerely worship him again him so they can live.
What three places does Yahweh tell the people not to go to worship?
Yahweh tells them not to go to Bethel, Gilgal, or Beersheba.
What will happen to the house of Joseph if they do not seek Yahweh?
Yahweh will destroy them completely, and no one will be able to stop it.
How do the people treat justice and righteousness, according to Yahweh?
They make unjust decisions, and they completely reject right living.
What is the name of the one who made the stars, turns darkness into morning, and makes the waters of the sea into rain that falls on the whole earth?
What does Yahweh do to those who are strong?
Yahweh brings sudden destruction on the strong.
Who do the strong hate and abhor?
The strong hate those who correct them, and abhor anyone who speaks the truth.
What will happen to those who oppress the poor?
Those who oppress the poor will not benefit from the things they work for.
What do the people do to the needy at the gate?
They treat the needy unjustly and send them away when they bring their legal matters to the leaders to decide.
What does a prudent person do at such an evil time?
A prudent person stays silent at such an evil time.
What should the people do so that Yahweh will be with them?
The people should try to do good and not evil, so that Yahweh will be with them.
What does Yahweh tell the people to do, so that he might be gracious to the remnant of Joseph?
Yahweh tells them to hate evil, love good, and establish justice in the gate.
What will be heard in all the public places when Yahweh comes to punish them?
Wailing and cries of mourning will be heard in all the public places when Yahweh passes through the people’s midst to punish them.
What will happen to those who are desiring the day of Yahweh to come?
Terrible things will happen to them; the day of Yahweh will be darkness, not light.
What happens to a man in this illustration who flees from a lion?
He flees the lion only to have a bear meet him, and he goes into his house to be safe only to have a snake bite him.
What will the day of Yahweh be?
The day of Yahweh will be a time of punishment for his people that will make them deeply sad.
What does Yahweh say about the people’s feasts and assemblies?
Yahweh says he hates their religious celebrations and their assemblies.
What does Yahweh say he will do if the people offer him burnt offerings and grain offerings?
Yahweh says he will not accept them.
What does Yahweh say about the people’s songs and music?
Yahweh says their songs are just noise to him, and he will not listen to their music.
What does Yahweh want to see people continually doing?
Yahweh wants to see people treating people fairly and doing what is right.
What does Yahweh say the people did not bring him during the forty years in the wilderness?
Yahweh says they did not bring him sacrifices and grain offerings.
What had the people made for themselves?
The people had made for themselves idols that were images of the false gods they were worshiping.
Where will Yahweh send the people?
Yahweh will exile the people beyond Damascus.
Who is Amos warning of Yahweh’s judgment?
Amos is warning the leaders in Zion and Samaria that terrible things will happen to them.
What cities does Yahweh tell the people of Israel to compare themselves to?
Yahweh tells them to go see Calneh, Hamath Rabbah, and Gath of the Philistines.
What do these people refuse to think about?
They refuse to think about the time that is coming when Yahweh will punish them.
What do these people eat while lying on beds of ivory and sprawling on their couches?
They eat young rams from the flock and calves from the stall.
What are those being warned doing with their time?
Those being warned are wasting their time idly playing musical instruments, drinking wine, and anointing themselves with the finest oil.
What are those being warned not doing that they should be doing?
Those being warned are not grieving over the destruction of the descendants of Joseph as they should.
Where are those being warned now going?
Those being warned are going to be forced to go into exile.
What does Yahweh hate about these people of Jacob?
Yahweh hates the pride and fortresses of these people of Jacob.
What will happen if even ten men survive in one house?
Even if ten men remain in one house, they will die.
Who will carry the dead body out of the house?
The dead man’s relative, the one who will burn his corpse, will carry the body out of the house.
What will happen to the houses of these people?
Their houses will be smashed to bits.
What have these people done instead of acting justly and righteously?
Instead of treating people justly, they have killed them, and instead of doing good for each other, they have made each other angry and resentful.
What do these people boast about capturing?
They boast about capturing the towns of Lo Debar and Karnaim by their own strength.
What does Yahweh declare he will do against the people of Israel?
Yahweh declares he will bring a foreign nation to attack Israel.
In his vision, what did Amos see Yahweh doing when the second crop of the season was starting to grow?
Amos saw Yahweh forming a locust swarm that would destroy the crop.
What was Yahweh’s response when Amos asked him to forgive and not send the swarm of locusts to punish his people?
Yahweh changed his mind and declared that this disaster would not happen.
In his vision, what did Amos see Yahweh summoning to punish his people?
Amos saw Yahweh bringing fire to punish his people.
What was Yahweh’s response when Amos asked him not to bring fire to punish the people?
Yahweh again relented and declared that this disaster would not happen either.
In his vision, where did Amos see the Lord standing?
Amos saw the Lord standing beside a wall with a plumb line in his hand.
What did the Lord say was the meaning of the plumb line?
The Lord said the plumb line meant he was going to test whether the Israelites were living rightly and this time, he would not hold back from punishing them.
What did Yahweh declare he would do to Israel?
Yahweh declared he would destroy the hilltop shrines and other holy places in Israel.
What did Amaziah the priest accuse Amos of doing?
Amaziah accused Amos of conspiring against Jeroboam, king of Israel.
What had Amos prophesied about Jeroboam?
Amos had prophesied that Jeroboam would be killed in battle.
Where did Amaziah tell Amos to flee to if he wanted to continue to prophesy?
Amos was told to flee to the land of Judah and prophesy there.
What did Amaziah tell Amos not to do at Bethel?
Amaziah told Amos not to prophesy at Bethel again, because it is the king’s sanctuary and a royal temple.
What was Amos’ work before Yahweh took him to be his prophet?
Amos was a herdsman and keeper of sycamore fig trees.
Why did Amos leave his work tending a flock of sheep?
Yahweh took him away from tending his sheep when he told him to go prophesy to the people of Israel.
What did Amos say that Amaziah was telling him not to do?
Amaziah was telling him not to prophesy against Israel or preach against the descendants of Isaac.
What did Yahweh prophesy against Amaziah, priest of Bethel?
Yahweh declared that Amaziah would die in an foreign land, his wife would be a prostitute, his sons and daughters would be killed, and his land would be divided up.
What did Yahweh show Amos in this vision?
Yahweh showed Amos a basket of summer fruit.
What did Yahweh say had come for his people Israel?
Yahweh said the end had come for his people Israel.
What did Yahweh say would happen to the songs of the temple in that day?
Yahweh said the songs of the temple would turn into wailing because of the many corpses everywhere.
What sins had the people of Israel committed?
The people of Israel had oppressed needy people and gotten rid of poor people in the land.
Why were the people anxious for the new moon and Sabbath to be over?
The people were anxious because they wanted to sell grain again and cheat their customers.
What were some of the things the merchants were doing
They were buying poor and needy people as slaves and selling worthless chaff along with the wheat.
What did Yahweh say he would never do?
Yahweh said he would never forget any of the people’s evil actions.
What did Yahweh say the land would do because of Yahweh’s punishment of people’s sins?
Yahweh said the land would tremble, heaving up and down, and everyone in it would mourn.
When Yahweh punishes Israel, what did he say he would do to the sun?
In that day, Yahweh said he would make the sun set at noon.
What would the people wear when Yahweh punishes them?
The people would wear sackcloth to show that they were grieving.
What famine did Yahweh say he would send in the land?
Yahweh said he would send a famine in the land, not a famine of food or water, but a famine of hearing the words of Yahweh.
What would the people search for but not find?
The people would search for a message from Yahweh but would not find it.
At that time, who would faint from thirst?
At that time, even the young women men would faint from thirst.
Who does Yahweh say would never rise again?
Those who swear by the idols and false gods would never rise again.
Who will escape the Lord’s judgment of Israel?
Not one of them will escape the Lord’s judgment.
What will the Lord do if people to escape his judgment and hide?
No matter where they try to hide, the Lord will find them.
What will the Lord do to those who might think they could hide on the bottom of the sea?
The Lord will give orders to the sea serpent to bite them.
For what purpose will the Lord watch over Israel?
The Lord will watch over Israel to bring them harm or punishment.
What do the people do when Yahweh touches the earth to melt it?
The people will mourn when Yahweh touches the earth to melt it.
What is the name of the one who does all these things?
From where did Yahweh bring Israel?
Yahweh brought Israel from the land of Egypt.
From where did Yahweh bring the Philistines?
Yahweh brought the Philistines from Caphtor.
Does Yahweh say he will totally destroy all the people of Israel?
No, Yahweh says he will not totally destroy the people of Israel but only the sinful northern kingdom.
What will Yahweh do to the house of Israel among the nations?
Yahweh will shake the house of Israel among the nations like grain in a sieve to determine who is faithful and who is not.
What were the sinners in Israel saying, those that Yahweh will kill?
The sinners were saying that nothing bad will happen to them.
In that day, what does Yahweh say he will restore?
In that day, Yahweh says that he will restore the kingdom that King David once ruled.
According to Yahweh, what will the people of Israel possess?
According to Yahweh, they will possess the remnant of Edom and all the nations that belong to him.
With what does Yahweh say the mountains will drip and the hills will melt in the coming days?
In the coming days, it will seem as if the mountains will drip and the hills will melt with sweet wine.
From what does Yahweh promise to bring Israel back?
Yahweh promises to bring Israel back from captivity.
After Yahweh brings Israel back, who will remove them from their land?
After Yahweh brings Israel back, no one will be able to remove them completely.
For what purpose did Yahweh send an ambassador among the nations?
Yahweh sent an ambassador among the nations to cause the nations to rise up for battle against Edom.
What was one of the sins of the Edomites?
The Edomites had pride in their hearts and believed that they could not be brought down to the ground.
Who will deceive and prevail against Edom?
The men who had an alliance of peace with Edom will deceive and prevail against Edom.
Why will Edom be covered with shame and cut off forever?
Edom will be covered with shame and cut off forever because of the violence Edom did to his brother Jacob.
What happened on the day that Edom stood aloof from Jacob?
On that day, strangers entered the gates of Jacob and took captive its wealth.
What did Yahweh tell Edom not to do regarding Judah in the day of Judah’s distress?
Yahweh said that Edom should not have looked, rejoiced, or made their mouth great.
What did Yahweh tell Edom not to do regarding Judah in the day of Judah’s calamity?
Yahweh said that Edom should not have entered Judah’s gates, rejoiced, or looted Judah’s wealth in the day of Judah’s calamity.
What did Yahweh say would return on Edom’s head?
Yahweh said that Edom’s recompense would return on Edom’s head.
What would some in Mount Zion be able to do despite the distress of Judah?
Some in Mount Zion would be able to escape despite the distress of Judah.
How many of Edom would escape the judgment of Yahweh?
There would be no survivors in Edom after Yahweh’s judgment.
Who would then possess the mount of Esau?
Those from the Negev would then possess the mount of Esau.
From where would the mountain of Esau then be judged?
The mountain of Esau would then be judged from Mount Zion.
